jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola Data Lover! 💙

En SDG, no solo tendrás la oportunidad de formar parte de algo increíble, ¡sino que vivirás lo que significa ser un auténtico especialista en Data & Analytics!

¿Estás preparadx para embarcarte en esta emocionante aventura? con nosotrxs, podrás potenciar todas tus habilidades y capacidades analíticas, tecnológicas y de negocio.

¡Es hora de despegar hacia el futuro mediante el poder de los datos! Únete a nosotros y prepárate para romper las reglas y alcanzar tu mejor versión 🚀✨.

Descubre el poder de SDG: líderes globales en la industria del dato 💥📊

En SDG trabajamos para la mitad de las empresas del IBEX-35, pero también en multitud de compañías internacionales. Gracias al boom de la analítica, estamos en un ritmo constante de crecimiento, y desde 1994 nos hemos convertido en el socio de confianza para empresas que desean maximizar todo el potencial de sus datos.

Si buscas formar parte de una compañía 100% especializada en #Data & #Analytics, ¡te estamos... esperando!

¿Qué te hará triunfar en está posición? 👇
• Contar de 2 a 5 años de experiencia trabajando con herramientas de visualización, ETL (modelado del dato) y BBDD SQL ya que son la base de todos los proyectos en los que estarás involucrado.
• Experiencia en lo que se refiere al desarrollo de cuadros de mando.
• Se requiere inglés alto ya que trabajarás en equipos globales.
• Estudios en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ciencia de datos, Industriales, o contar con un Ciclo Superior u otra salida académica que te haya dotado de capacidad de desarrollo y pensamiento crítico en este ambiente.

¿Cuál será tu misión? ✍
• Formarás parte del crecimiento de la compañía liderando proyectos de analítica.
• Serás un referente técnico para todos tus colaboradores.

¿Qué nos hace diferentes? 🧐

En nuestros proyectos, los datos y la tecnología son los protagonistas, te formaremos para que puedas trabajar con lo último del mercado (tenemos un área de innovación dónde impulsamos nuevos partnerships con fabricantes tecnológicos y centros de I+D).

Tendrás todas las oportunidades para alcanzar tu mejor versión, con un plan de carrera totalmente personalizado en el que aprenderás por ti mismo y además, contarás con el apoyo del resto de compañerxs.

Tu mismo te marcarás tus propios tiempos, semestralmente hablarás con tu responsable para compartir feedback y nuevos retos, y en base a tus resultados, habrá una revisión salarial.

Somos una gran familia, desde el minuto 1 trataremos de hacerte la vida más fácil. Tanto tus compañerxs como el resto de equipo siempre tendrán una sonrisa y estarán dispuestos a ayudarte y ofrecerte todo su apoyo.

Colaborarás y trabajarás en tu día a día con grandes referentes (técnicos y/o de negocio), estarán encantados de enseñarte todo lo posible y se sentirán orgullosxs de verte crecer.

Con nosotros el Smartwork es posible. Vivirás una forma de trabajo en la que cada uno gestiona su propio tiempo.

Somos una marca con propósito. Creemos que la diversidad y la inclusión ayudan a promover una cultura de creatividad, permitiéndonos superar nuevas situaciones y desafíos.

Metiéndonos un poco más en temas más formales, pero no menos importantes, ofrecemos contrato indefinido, ¡queremos que te quedes con nosotrxs mucho tiempo!, salario competitivo de acuerdo con tú nivel de formación y experiencia (no te preocupes, ya qué, en la primera entrevista, trataremos este aspecto y te informaremos si tus expectativas están alineadas) y te ofrecemos una ayuda económica para gastos ocasionados por el teletrabajo.

Podríamos continuar detallando que nos hace especiales, y nos encantará hacerlo en todas las fases de entrevistas.

INSCRÍBETE AHORA ¡ESTAMOS DESEANDO CONOCERTE

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Manager - Canary Islands
jobs_results.description:
Seniority Level: Mid-Senior Level

#Ownership

Business Intelligence Manager

Canary Islands

At Cervecera de Canarias (part of the AB InBev family), we currently have an excellent opportunity for a Business Intelligence Manager.

At AB InBev, dreaming big is what we do. Brewing the world’s most loved beers and crafting meaningful moments are what inspire us.

We’re a team of passionate owners who aren’t afraid to dream big because we know that together, we can achieve anything. To build a more sustainable, inclusive and rewarding future. Turning any challenge into an opportunity. So let’s take on the challenge together. Cheers to dreaming big!  

The role:
• Responsible for managing and developing the Business Intelligence team (TechSales, CatMan & RevMan).
• Responsible for identifying trends, consumption patterns and market/business opportunities with the objective of advising on making high-impact commercial decisions; based on external information -Nielsen- and internal sales... information.
• Direct report to the Commercial Head.
• In charge of the integration between commercial intelligence and the digital sales tools BEES -b2b- & TaDa -b2c-.
• Participate in the strategic business cycle from the company's 10-year plan to the following year's operation.
• Building business insights to answer business questions, drive business decisions, and develop recommendations to improve operations.
• Drive a business intelligence roadmap; prioritise analysis requests to balance the tactical and strategic information needs of the business.
• Present analysis and recommendations to senior leaders, using data-driven storytelling and influence to drive improvements in business operations and strategic change. Coordinate with decision makers in the company to ensure that information collection and analysis supports the overall development of business strategies.
• Collaborate with other departments to identify and generate potential business intelligence initiatives that result in business efficiency, cost savings and/or marketing/commerce effectiveness.
• Lead the definition and governance of key business metrics, drive the vision and creation of automated dashboards and self-service analytics capabilities, and design data-driven processes that drive business value.

Who we’re looking for:
• At least 5 -10 years of relevant work experience
• Excellent in analysis and problem solving.
• Excellent in communication, presentation, persuasion and project management.
• Excellent in team management and coaching skills.
• Bachelor's or master's degree in business, finance, economics or a related field.
• Experience in providing analysis for business decisions in marketing, trade marketing, sales and supply chain.
• Fluent Spanish and English (C1/C2)

In this role, you’ll have the potential to transform our business and your career. You’ll get the support and mentor you need to succeed. We’re a meritocracy, with plenty of room for growth and development, so you know your hard work will be rewarded. We encourage you to think big and go after your goals. You’ll get to be creative, work with international teams so you can build a global network and have direct control over your career and where it takes you.

We are building a team that’s more supportive, more inclusive and more collaborative. A team that’s diverse in background, skills and experience.

So if you dream big but are concerned you’re not a perfect fit against the job description, we’d still encourage you to apply. You may just the right candidate to help us create a future with more cheers.

As the leading global brewer, we are committed to bringing people together for a better – and more equal – world. A more equal world starts when everyone can thrive. At AB InBev we value the diversity of cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce, and we strongly encourage women, people of colour, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.

ZoneEUR

jobs_results.title: PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN CERRADO. BECA BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

LO QUE SOMOS

En MediaMarkt somos especialistas en acercar la tecnología a nuestr@s clientes y líderes en el sector de la electrónica de consumo. En España y Portugal, nuestro equipo está formado por más de 7.000 personas que, desde nuestras 107 tiendas, la web, y nuestro Headquarter, trabajamos para ofrecer el mejor servicio y los mejores productos día a día. Nos adaptamos rápidamente a los cambios estando a la última en las tendencias del retail. Y no, no todos somos Geeks, pero sí que tenemos una cosa en común: pasión por lo que hacemos.

ASÍ SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA
• Formación en infraestructura de datos, cloud y metodología de trabajo Agile.
• Colaborar en procesos de integración, transformación y carga en DWH.
• Creación, evolución y mantenimiento de informes transversales a la compañía.
• Tareas de soporte al equipo de BI.

El stack tecnológico principal que actualmente utilizamos para desarrollar los nuevos proyectos se compone de:
• Visualización de datos: PowerBI... Tableau, DataStudio, Looker
• Servicios de datos en plataforma Google Cloud Platform
• SQL
• Python, java
• Git

NOTA

Preguntar retribución a la empresa.

Requisitos

Departamento BI
• Estudios mínimos

Educación Secundaria Obligatoria
• Experiencia mínima

No Requerida

LO QUE ESPERAMOS DE TI
• Posibilidad de formalizar un convenio de prácticas con el centro de estudios.
• Estar cursando un grado/máster relacionado con Ciencias de datos
• Conocimientos en analítica (principales métricas e indicadores)
• Imprescindible buen manejo de Excel y Power BI (herramienta de trabajo diario)
• Valorables conocimientos intermedios en inglés (B1-B2).
• Valorable conocimiento en programación (Python, java o similares)
• Valorable conocimiento en SQL
• Pensamiento analítico
• Atención al detalle.
• Ganas de aprender.
• Organización y planificación.
• Trabajo en equipo

jobs_results.title: Técnico/a de Business Intelligence - EAE (Madrid)
jobs_results.description:
Descripción del empleo

Desde Grupo Planeta EAE Business School Madrid , estamos buscando un perfil Técnico/a de Business Intelligence (EAE) que quiera formar parte del equipo de Customer Ex, cuya misión principal es ofrecer una experiencia satisfactoria a nuestros clientes.

Mision

En EAE Business School Madrid estamos buscando un profesional altamente motivado y experimentado para unirse a nuestro equipo como Especialista en Business Intelligence y Automatización con enfoque en herramientas de Microsoft, como Power BI, Power Automate y Power Apps.
El candidato ideal será responsable de la creación de cuadros de mando, diseño de KPIs y automatización de procesos para mejorar la eficiencia operativa de la empresa.

¿En qué consistirá tu día a día?
• Colaborar con los equipos de negocio para entender los requisitos y diseñar soluciones de Business Intelligence que impulsen la toma de decisiones informada.
• Crear cuadros de mando efectivos utilizando Power BI, integrando datos de... diversas fuentes como Excel, Microsoft Lists y otras fuentes pertinentes.
• Diseñar y desarrollar KPIs clave para medir el rendimiento de diferentes áreas de la empresa.
• Automatizar procesos empresariales utilizando Microsoft Power Apps, garantizando una integración eficiente con otros sistemas.
• Mantener y mejorar continuamente los informes y dashboards existentes para satisfacer las cambiantes necesidades comerciales.
• Proporcionar formación y soporte a los usuarios finales para garantizar la adopción efectiva de las soluciones implementadas.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato estable: Indefinido y a jornada completa.
• Podrás desarrollarte profesionalmente gracias a nuestros planes de formación y desarrollo de talento interno.
• Descuentos y promociones exclusivas para nuestros empleados (masters y posgrados, sellos editoriales, coleccionables, Casa del Libro…)
• Un atractivo paquete de beneficios sociales a través del plan de retribución flexible que incluye: tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico, etc
Requisitos mínimos
Requisitos mínimos:
• Experiencia demostrada en la creación de cuadros de mando y diseño de KPIs utilizando Power BI.
• Conocimiento sólido de Microsoft Power Apps y capacidad para desarrollar soluciones de automatización.
• Experiencia en la integración de datos de diferentes fuentes, como Excel, Microsoft Lists y otras plataformas.
• Habilidades analíticas y capacidad para traducir datos en información significativa para la toma de decisiones.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
Experiencia en la formación y soporte a usuarios finales.
• Certificaciones en Power BI, Power Automate y Power Apps serán consideradas como un plus

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
Business Intelligence

Location: Barcelona, hybrid.

At K-LAGAN we are waiting for you to continue growing together

We are a strategic international technology services company, essentially committed to its team and to society. We offer solutions in IT services, engineering developments, electronics, and R&D projects. Our commitment is to hire the best talent regardless of race, religion, gender, age and people with other abilities, promoting their professional and personal development.

Mission : As SR Business Intelligence , you will work on managing data storage, securing and organising data, as well as planning how to obtain this data and identifying errors or weaknesses that can be improved.

Our ideal profile has knowledge in:

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

jobs_results.title: Alternance Data Management et Business Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
A la recherche de votre alternance pour la rentrée de septembre 2024 ?
Vous souhaitez approfondir vos connaissances du Commerce, de la Data et de la Business Intelligence ?

Alors venez contribuer au développement de notre marque Thermor et intégrer nos équipes en tant qu' alternant Data Management et Business Intelligence (F/H), à partir de septembre 2024 pour 2 ans sur notre site d' Orléans (45).

VOTRE CHALLENGE ?
Au sein de la direction de la performance commerciale, vous participez à :
- garantir la fiabilité et la complétude des données,
- assurer le suivi des indicateurs liés au pilotage de l'activité commerciale,
- fournir des analyses détaillées de la donnée commerciale,
- construire et mettre à jour les tableaux de bords décisionnels.

VOS ATOUTS ?
Futur diplômé d'une école de commerce ou d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation dans les sciences de la donnée ?
Vous maîtrisez le pack office notamment Excel et ses fonctionnalités ainsi que le logiciel Power BI.
Vous avez des... connaissances solides sur le langage SQL ; Python ou R seraient un plus.
On vous décrit comme une personne rigoureuse avec un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.
Attaché au travail en équipe, votre sens du service vous permet de proposer des solutions et de respecter les délais de la roadmap du service

jobs_results.title: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE MANAGER
jobs_results.description:
About Kosmos

Founded in Barcelona in 2017, KOSMOS is a Barcelona based holding company, founded and chaired by professional football player Gerard Piqué, and backed by Hiroshi Mikitani, the Chairman and CEO of Rakuten. At KOSMOS we are passionate about building a global portfolio of high-quality sports, media, and entertainment companies. With a particular focus on sports and exclusive access, we are capitalizing on and shaping this quickly growing landscape.

At KOSMOS, we’re always dreaming about going further. We are constantly pushing ourselves to innovate and create new things.

The Kings & Queens Leagues are exciting competitions that seamlessly merge sport and entertainment in a very creative way. With renowned content creators as club presidents, we propose to play sports with new and disruptive rules, all streamed live on social media.

About The Role

As a Business Intelligence Manager at KOSMOS, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable... insights that drive strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the Business Intelligence (BI) team, collaborating with cross-functional departments, and implementing effective BI solutions to enhance the company's performance and competitive edge in the sports industry.

Main Responsibilities:
• Data Strategy and Governance:
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data strategy aligned with business objectives.
• Establish and enforce data governance policies, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and security.
• BI Solution Development:
• Design and implement scalable and efficient BI solutions to extract insights from structured and unstructured data sources.
• Utilize cutting-edge BI tools and technologies to create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that facilitate decision-making processes.
• Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Collaborate with key stakeholders across departments to understand their analytical needs and provide insights that drive business outcomes.
• Act as a liaison between the BI team and other business units to ensure alignment and understanding of data-related initiatives.
• Performance Monitoring and Optimization:
• Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitor the company's performance against these metrics.
• Continuously optimize BI processes to enhance efficiency and relevance of insights provided to decision-makers.
• Training and Development:
• Provide training sessions and resources to empower end-users to leverage BI tools effectively.
• Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, incorporating relevant advancements into the BI strategy.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
• You have demonstrated at least 8 to 10 years of experience in data analytics and/or BI.
• Advanced level of written and spoken English.
• Proficiency in BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of data warehousing, ETL processes, and data modelling.
• Excellent leadership, communication, influence and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to translate complex data concepts into business insights for non-technical stakeholders.
• Knowledge of sports industry trends and dynamics.
• Proven experience in a managerial role within Business Intelligence or Analytics.
• Experience with advanced analytics, machine learning, or predictive modelling.
• Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

OUR PROPOSITION
• Competitive base salary
• Flexible working hours
• Flexible compensation plan
• A diverse and inclusive working environment
• Equal employment opportunity for everyone.

Interested? If you have the profile for this Business Intelligence Manager role and want to join a talented and innovative team, we’d love to hear from you

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Opportunity

This is an exciting time for BI & Analytics in ESW as we continue to build out a sustainable and scalable data environment that provides us with the ability to leverage the latest tools and technologies available through the cloud (Google & Azure) to facilitate fast, data-driven management decisions, and discover new insights in the ever-growing eCommerce industry. Within the Data team, we have an opportunity for a motivated, curious and talented BI Engineer who is interested in working with a wide range of Google Cloud Platform services and the Looker BI platform.

This role offers the successful candidate several opportunities to upskill with the latest technologies in the market (GCP, Looker, Azure DevOps), the agile framework SAFe, application of CI/CD delivery, security, DevOps, etc., all the while working in a fully cloud-based environment.

Key Responsibilities
• You should be committed to delivering fast and quality and possess a passion for data and the value... it can bring.
• You will work with BI and the wider business to translate business requirements into solutions (Data Modelling + LookML + Looks + Dashboard) to deliver business insights, trends, and analysis visually compellingly through Looker and supporting platforms.
• Ensure the deployment of updates/enhancements to the Looker production environment aligns with our deployment workflow standards and procedures.
• Create and enhance documentation as solutions require e.g. high-level design specifications, business glossary updates, data model architecture updates, etc.
• Work with the Product team to ensure there is a clear understanding of requirements and deliverables as part of any new feature requests.
• Work as a member of the BI scrum team to ensure there is clarity and alignment to current and future work items – providing the necessary input into user stories as required, estimating user stories, and engaging in all scrum-related ceremonies.
• You will work closely with teams across our business to understand their business problems/requirements and proactively design and champion solutions to deliver the required business value.
• Support the maintenance of legacy reporting (SQL Server & SharePoint) and all activities attached to the migration of these reports onto the Looker platform.

Key Experience & Skills
• A degree in a relevant discipline, e.g. Information Systems (Business or Computing).
• Deep knowledge of databases and T-SQL or query-writing skills - SQL Server, MySQL, or similar.
• Knowledge of query optimization and performance tuning.
• Exposure to BI tools, such as Looker, Microsoft (SSIS, SSRS, SharePoint), Tableau, QlikView or Excel BI tools – PowerPivot/Power BI.
• Demonstrable skills in understanding complex business problems and translating those to simple-to-use BI solutions or reports.
• Understanding of what can be improved through better data and analysis.
• An understanding of dimensional data models using methodology such as Kimball would be advantageous.
• Knowledge of eCommerce or Supply Chain would also be an advantage.
• Experience with GIT or other version control systems and exposure to Agile and Scrum methodologies will be beneficial.

Desired Behaviours
• You should be eager to work in a fast-paced eCommerce environment.
• Demonstrate willingness and openness to learning new technologies and practices.
• Excellent personal organisation & work-management skills – ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
• Strong problem-solving skills.
• Ability to apply business acumen to data-driven outputs to deliver value-added insights.
• Ability to present clear and concise outputs articulating how data and analysis relate to Key Performance Indicators.
• High level of dedication to see things through to completion, with high quality.
• Strong level of versatility & willingness to contribute to a company with phenomenal growth.
• Willingness to contribute to conversations and propose ideas.
• Commitment to deliver good service to our internal and external partners.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and a career path adapted to each person's abilities and experience within a company that is growing continuously.
• 2 days a week working from home.
• A flexible schedule and total conciliation between work and family life including reduced timetable during one month in summer.
• Become part of a multi-cultural company where you can contribute with your experience and learn from the experience of others.
• Work with amazing brands.
• Get the opportunity to influence the future of our services and platform.
• Excellent working environment with frequent social activities (hackathons, Spartan races, quarterly whole-team social event).
• Central Madrid office located an 8-minute walk from Atocha train station, with a bus stop and BiciMad station right outside the office.
• Kitchen and dining facilities as well as a fully stocked games room with games consoles etc. - great to disconnect from work for a while and have fun with your colleagues.
• Discounted parking space in the office building if you’re coming by car, bicycle parking for those worried about their carbon footprint.
• Access to private sales by some of the exclusive brands we work with.
• Enrollment in English, French, and Spanish lessons that take place during working hours.
• Mental Health Wellbeing Program.

About us:

ESW is the leading global and domestic direct-to-consumer (DTC) ecommerce company, empowering the world's best-loved brands to create safer, simpler and faster shopping experiences for consumers all around the globe. ESW acquired Scalefast in June 2022, and the combined 1,300 person organization offers brands and retailers a complete portfolio of technology and services that cost-effectively support any stage of company's development.

From compliance, data security, fraud protection, taxes and tariffs to demand generation, checkout, delivery, returns and customer service, our powerful combination of technology and human ingenuity covers the entire shopper journey across 200 markets, with 100% carbon neutral shipping to consumers. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, ESW has global offices in the US, UK, Spain, France, Italy, Japan, Hong Kong and Singapore. ESW is an Asendia Group company, a joint venture between La Poste and Swiss Post
